description: The file defines a service module for fetching and normalizing category taxonomy data, either from a backend API endpoint or from a local JSON file. It provides functions to retrieve category data with fallbacks and to ensure data consistency.

methods.name: getCategoryTaxonomy()
methods.description: Fetches the category taxonomy from a backend API if configured, otherwise loads from local JSON. Returns a normalized array of category objects.

methods.name: normalizeTaxonomy(input)
methods.description: Cleans and ensures each taxonomy item has a 'name' string and an array of 'subcategories'.
